# FeatureCard

Flat square card on a light tint — Infoquest's only card style.

`InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.FeatureCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.FeatureCard title={…}>…</InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.FeatureCard>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.FeatureCard" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Flat, square tinted card — value props ("Custom-Sourced Experts"), service lines, additional services. No border, no shadow.
